no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-exercises
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Exercises filters movements by target muscle group, equipment, and exercise name, returning matching exercises with their force type and required gear. Paid plans add step-by-step instructions, difficulty levels, and movement mechanics.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-emailvalidator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Email Validator checks whether an email address is valid, deliverable and safe. It validates the format, resolves the domain's mail (MX) records, flags disposable and role-based addresses, and returns a composite risk score with typo correction.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-emojilookup
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Emoji Lookup searches emoji characters, tags, or categories to return descriptive names and classifications. Query by raw symbol, keyword tag, or category to inspect matching emoji glyphs, text descriptions, and categories.

no_pyproject_toml.name: lizard-sdk
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Python SDK for Lizard: Firecracker microVM sandboxes, code execution and cloud apps.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-disposableemailchecker
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Disposable Email Checker is a disposable email detection API that tests whether an email address belongs to a disposable or temp mail provider. Pass any email to receive its domain and a true or false flag showing if it is temporary.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-domainavailability
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Domain Availability checks domain availability in real time to show if a web address is open for registration or already taken. Get creation and expiration dates for taken domains, while paid plans add registrar details and what the domain costs to register and renew.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-dogbreeds
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Dog Breeds searches canine breed records by name to return official breed names and kennel club group classifications. Paid plans add height, weight, lifespan, traits, and original breeding purposes.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-domainexpiration
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Domain Expiration tracks domain expiration health and domain age for any web address. It returns days remaining until expiry, an expiration status, and age in days and years, with paid plans adding exact registration timestamps.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-dnslookup
no_pyproject_toml.summary: DNS Lookup retrieves published DNS records for any domain, including IPv4 (A), IPv6 (AAAA), and mail exchange (MX) servers. It provides hostnames, priorities, and dual-stack status flags, while paid plans add TXT, CNAME, and nameserver records.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-distancecalculator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Distance Calculator computes the distance between two coordinate pairs in miles and kilometers. Supply two latitude and longitude points to receive distances and resolved city and state names for both locations.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-dictionary
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Dictionary looks up word definitions for any given term. It returns every recorded meaning as a text list with a total definition count for e-readers, vocabulary builders, and writing assistants.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-datecalculator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Date Calculator computes the difference between two calendar dates in minutes, hours, days, weeks, months, and years. Supply start and end dates in YYYY-MM-DD format to receive exact interval breakdowns.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-dadjokes
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Dad Jokes delivers a random dad joke with every request. Send a plain GET call without parameters to receive a clean punchline ready for display.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-currencysymbols
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Currency Symbols matches ISO currency codes or country names to the countries that use them. Paid plans add the currency symbol, full currency name, ISO numeric code, and decimal precision.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-currencyconverter
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Currency Converter calculates foreign exchange conversions across 170+ currencies using real-time rates. Pass an amount with source and target currency codes to receive the converted total, exchange rate, and 24-hour trend direction.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-countrylookup
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Country Lookup matches any country name or ISO code to its official names, ISO 3166 codes, capitals, region, languages, and flag emoji. Paid plans add coordinates and major cities.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-countydatalookup
no_pyproject_toml.summary: County Data Lookup is a county lookup API that retrieves income, poverty rate, and life expectancy for any US county by state and county name. Paid plans add age demographics, educational attainment, health indicators, ZIP codes, and cost of living.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-countrylanguages
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Country Languages lists official and commonly spoken languages for any country using its two-letter ISO code. It returns the common country name, formal official name, an array of recognized languages, and the total language count.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-countryflags
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Country Flags is a country flag API that fetches direct download URLs for national flag images using two-letter ISO country codes. Responses return the country name, ISO code, and image link, while paid plans can select SVG or PNG formats and shapes.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-cloudcounter
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Cloud Counter stores and updates persistent numeric counters by ID without needing a database. It tracks increments, decrements, and custom values while returning timestamps and number properties like parity and prime status.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-countryboundaries
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Country Boundaries retrieves GeoJSON border outlines for any country by its two-letter ISO code. Each response includes the country name, geometry type, and boundary coordinate pairs ready for mapping layers.

no_pyproject_toml.name: openreceive
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Bitcoin Lightning checkout for Django, FastAPI, Flask and Python apps, with receive-only wallet access and optional USDT, USDC, ETH and SOL swaps.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-coordinatesaresea
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Coordinates Are Sea checks whether a given latitude and longitude pair sits in the ocean or on land. Pass geographic coordinates to receive a boolean confirming if the location is in the sea.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-countryborders
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Country Borders identifies adjacent nations by two-letter ISO country code. It returns the list of bordering countries along with region, subregion, and landlocked status.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-citieslookup
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Cities Lookup is a city search API that searches over 150,000 global cities to find country codes, population counts, and city size classifications by name. Paid plans add GeoJSON coordinates and custom match limits.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-contactextractor
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Contact Extractor scrapes public email addresses, phone numbers, and physical addresses from any web page URL. It tallies the findings and returns unique records found on the page.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-companynamegenerator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Company Name Generator generates business name ideas from a seed keyword, returning a list of suggested brand names. Supply any industry or concept word to receive ready-made brand naming suggestions.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-colorpalettegenerator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Color Palette Generator produces harmonious color schemes from any HEX base color. It returns color codes in HEX and RGB formats, naming matches, dark-mode flags, and recommended text colors.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-commentgenerator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Comment Generator produces social media comments formatted for text or image posts across positive, negative, and neutral tones. Each request returns generated comment text with optional emoji support, while paid plans can request batches up to 10.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-colorconverter
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Color Converter translates color values across hex, RGB, CMYK, and named inputs into standard RGB formats and channel breakdowns. Paid plans expand output to include CMYK, HSL, ANSI 16-color codes, and recognized English color names.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-coinflipper
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Coin Flipper simulates random coin flips and records heads or tails outcomes with flip counts. Paid plans can simulate multiple flips per request and calculate percentages, streak lengths, and fairness indicators.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-codedetector
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Code Detector identifies the programming language of any submitted code snippet. It returns the canonical language name, readable title, and standard file extension for the detected code.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-cocktailrecipe
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Cocktail Recipe retrieves cocktail recipes by drink name or ingredient, providing measured ingredients, preparation instructions, and recommended glassware. Responses include serving categories and ingredient counts, with support for pulling random drinks.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-chucknorrisjokes
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Chuck Norris Jokes delivers a random Chuck Norris joke on every request without requiring any query parameters. Each call returns plain joke text ready to display in bots, command-line interfaces, or entertainment feeds.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-chinesezodiac
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Chinese Zodiac returns the zodiac animal, element, and characteristics for any birth date. Accurately accounts for the Chinese lunar calendar - the zodiac year starts on Chinese New Year, not January 1st.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-chessmovevalidator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Chess Move Validator verifies algebraic chess notation and identifies move types including castling, captures, checks, and promotions.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-charadesgenerator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Charades Generator provides random words from curated categories perfect for playing the classic charades acting game.

no_pyproject_toml.name: labnotes
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Browse experiment designs, notes, and run data from a folder.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-chartgenerator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Chart Generator is a chart API that turns your data into chart and graph images. Supports bar, line, pie, doughnut, radar, and polar area charts with customizable styling.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-testcardgenerator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Test Card Generator creates card numbers that pass format and checksum validation, for testing checkout forms and payment UIs across major networks. They aren't real cards: no bank issued them, and they can't be charged or used to buy anything. Specify a brand to receive card numbers, security codes, expiration dates, issuers, and masked strings.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-uscarmodels
no_pyproject_toml.summary: US Car Models is a car make and model API for vehicles sold in the United States from 1984 to present. List models by make on any plan, while paid plans add year filters, trims, fuel economy (MPG), engine details, and transmission specifications.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-cardvalidator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Card Validator checks whether a card number is valid, identifies the card brand, and flags risk. It runs the Luhn checksum, detects the scheme (Visa, Mastercard, Amex and more), returns the PCI-safe BIN and last 4 digits, flags known processor test cards, and returns a composite risk score.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-carddeckshuffler
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Card Deck Shuffler randomizes standard playing card decks using Fisher-Yates or riffle algorithms. Pass the deck count and optional jokers to get the full ordered cards with rank, suit, shorthand symbols, and the top card.

no_pyproject_toml.name: freepod
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Command-line client for Freepod — take a local project directory to a running deployment on freepod.eu.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-captchagenerator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Captcha Generator generates visual captcha challenges with signed image URLs and text solutions. Each request delivers a challenge image, its correct answer string, an expiration timestamp, and a unique identifier.

no_pyproject_toml.name: jupyterlab-ai-code-assistants-extension
no_pyproject_toml.summary: A full launcher and manager for every AI code assistant in JupyterLab - Claude Code, Codex, Kimi, Gemini and DeepSeek. Start, resume, fork, switch, and clean up CLI sessions from a side panel per assistant - one click lands you in the right terminal with the assistant already running, no duplicate tabs, no UUID hunting.
